claims.evidence: The photo shows a clean exterior, but internal mechanical condition is unknown.

risks.risk: The bike may have a broken or seized rear wheel axle.
risks.proof: A video showing the wheel spinning freely and the axle being turned.

risks.risk: The drivetrain (gears and chain) may be stripped or rusted.
risks.proof: A video of the bike being pedaled through all gear positions.

risks.risk: The brakes may be worn or ineffective.
risks.proof: A video showing the brakes being applied and the wheels stopping.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the bike being pedaled to check the drivetrain and gears.
Video of the brakes being operated.
Video of the rear wheel being spun to check the axle.
response.reason: The brand and type are clearly identified from the photo, allowing for a valuation at the worst-case functional state.
